statement: The landing preflight silent-catch runner no longer crashes on changed paths that no longer exist in the worktree: silentCatchProblems in scripts/solve/landing-preflight.js filters deleted/absent files exactly as staticQualityProblems already does, so a Quest whose candidate includes a file deletion can mint a review manifest instead of dying on fs.stat ENOENT. doneWhen: solve/oracle/solver-landing-preflight-deleted-path-filter-v2.json reads metric 0 (focused red-first test in test/solve/operator-workflow.test.js proves a manifest naming a deleted path passes the preflight silent-catch stage while existing paths are still checked; fails 2 assertions when the fix is reverted).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
